articles.title: Revolut wants to take Dogecoin mainstream with its new physical payment card
articles.snippet: The European fintech giant is launching a physical debit card that lets users spend the popular meme coin anywhere Visa and Mastercard are accepted with zero extra exchange fees.

articles.title: Solana is shedding its memecoin reputation as big banks move billions into its ecosystem
articles.snippet: Wall Street and payment giants are quietly taking over Solana, moving billions onto the network for tokenized funds and global payments even as the broader crypto market cools down, according to a new report by Messari.

articles.title: Mike Novogratz’s Galaxy receives New York BitLicense for institutional crypto push
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital became the second company this year to secure a New York BitLicense, following Strike’s approval in March.

articles.title: Stripe-backed Tempo taps $7.5 billion DeFi lender Morpho to expand beyond payments
articles.snippet: The move brings onchain yield and lending to the payments-focused chain in a bid to offer full-stack onchain finance platform to companies building on it.

articles.title: HIVE buys $58 million Toronto plot for AI facility; shares climb
articles.snippet: The bitcoin mining firm continues on its investment path into AI data centers after raising $115 million to expand its global footprint in the industry.
